NARRATIVE AND PLANS ATTACHMENT
TYPE I Rezoning from B3-2 to B3-3
2018 — 20 North Halsted Street
The Project

The property is improved with a three-story mixed-use building with ground floor commercial space, four
residential units on the upper floors and no parking. The Applicant seeks to rezone the property to allow a rear
addition to the second floor with a retractable roof to convert its use to commercial space. After construction of the
proposed addition, the building will contain commercial space in the basement, first and second floor for a total of

14,677 sq. ft. and two residential dwelling units on the third floor. No parking will be added. The height of the
building is and will remain at 45,33 feet.

The property is located on the west side of North Halsted Street in an area that is primarily improved with commercial,
mixed-use (commercial and residential) and multi-family residential buildings ranging in height from one to four
stories. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject
property from the property’s current B3-2 Community Shopping District to a B3-3 Community Shopping District
under a Voluntary Type I Map Amendment. The area has a mix of zoning classifications, including RT-4, RM-4.5,
RM-S, B3-2, B1-3 and Cl-2. It is improved with multiple buildings of similar size, scale, and density to the subject
building as proposed to be redeveloped. Halsted Street along the property’s frontage is a Pedestrian Retail Street.
The property is within the Armitage Halsted Chicago Landmark District and the Sheffield National Register Historic
District. The property also is a Transit Served Location per the Transit-Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B (1), as it is located on Halsted Street a designated bus line corridor in Table 17-17-
0400-B, 969 feet from the CTA Armitage Station, and 2,556 feet from the CTA Fullerton Station. Accordingly, the
property qualifies for a parking reduction under the Transit Served provision of the Zoning Ordinance

The Applicant also seeks as part of the Type 1 rezoning per Section 17-13-0303-D an Administrative Adjustment
under Section 17-13-1003-EE to reduce the required parking from 12 spaces to zero.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 6,242.00 square feet

Floor Area: 14,677.00 square feet

Maximum FAR: 2.35

Residential Dwelling Units: 2

MLA Density: 3,121 square feet

Height (existing): 45.33 feet

Bicycle Parking: 12 spaces

Automobile Parking: None

Setbacks: Front (Halsted Street): None
North Side: None
South Side: None
Rear (Alley): None

*A set of plans, including a site plan showing the TSL distance of 0.0 feet to Halsted Street.
